symptoms.symptom: The appliance is not cooling, the displays and lighting are lit.

causes.label: Showroom mode is switched on.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 15
Wait 2 minutes.
Switch the appliance back on. Page 15
Wait 1 minute and then hold down super (Refrigera-
tor compartment) until 4 audible signals sound.
After a short time, check whether your appliance is
cooling.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 23: "Showroom mode is switched on."

symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 23: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources.
Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

remedies: Press alarm.

causes.label: The appliance door is open.

remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 15
Switch the appliance back on after approximately
